title: SafeFUME™ Automatic Cyanoacrylate Fuming Chambers
meta_title: SafeFUME Cyanoacrylate Fuming Chambers for Fingerprint Development
meta_description: Innovative SafeFUME cyanoacrylate fuming chambers create a safe work environment for developing latent fingerprints using methylcyanoacrylate (CNA) vapor.
meta_keywords: cyanoacrylate fuming chamber, fingerprint development, forensic equipment, crime scene investigation, law enforcement
short_description: SafeFUME™ cyanoacrylate fuming chambers are designed to safely develop latent fingerprints using methylcyanoacrylate (CNA) vapor in a controlled environment.
full_description: Choose from multiple sizes, from bench top to floor standing. Multi-chamber cabinets available. Caster wheels standard on all models except bench top series. Optional UV Lamp decontamination. Optional side and rear windows for 360° view of development.

page_content_sections.overview: Choose from multiple sizes, from bench top to floor standing. Multi-chamber cabinets available. Caster wheels standard on all models except bench top series. Optional UV Lamp decontamination. Optional side and rear windows for 360° view of development.
page_content_sections.specifications: Constructed with epoxy-coated steel and polypropylene. Complies with OSHA, ISO 14001, and ISO 9001 standards. 120V, 60Hz electrical with NEMA 5-15P plug. Upflow airflow with 145 fpm face velocity and 22 lb main filter.
page_content_sections.applications: Used in state and federal crime labs, crime scene investigation, law enforcement, medical examiner programs, and criminal justice education.
page_content_sections.models: Multiple model sizes available from 24" to 60" width, with bench top and upright configurations.
